summary: The mobile layout cleanly integrates resizable panels, sparklines, and native selects with minor contrast and text truncation constraints.

issues.title: Text truncation in region selector
issues.description: Region option label truncates due to tight half-width column sizing on mobile.
issues.evidence: Option text reads 'us-east-1 · Virgi...' with an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Stack selects vertically or allocate more width to region.

issues.title: Low contrast secondary text
issues.description: Secondary metrics and event log descriptions have borderline readability against the dark background.
issues.evidence: Log detail strings and metric labels use very dark muted gray text.
issues.suggestion: Bump secondary text brightness token for better legibility.
